entries.claims: Zero-product definition, positive-dimensional failure of a unit, Jordan category membership, and complete End/Aut classifications in all recorded scalar-linear Jordan views.
entries.evidence: The Jordan identity is 0=0. For nonzero x, e*x=0 is never x, so no unit exists. Product preservation imposes no constraint beyond field linearity, and invertible linear maps have product-preserving linear inverses. Coordinates give M_k(F) and GL_k(F); restricting complex scalars doubles real dimension.
